landing.heroSubtitle: Complete your One Time Registration with a live photograph and verified documents. Get a permanent OTR ID and apply for any exam without filling your details again.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
body: Vensysco Technologies Limited operates the VTL One Time Registration Platform as a data processor on behalf of examination bodies (data fiduciaries) under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

Purpose: your personal data (identity, contact, category, education, photograph and signature) is collected only to create your One Time Registration and to process your applications for examinations you choose to apply for.
Security: personal data is encrypted at rest, transmitted only over secure connections and accessed only by authorised staff. Every access and change is recorded in an audit log.
Sharing: data is shared only with the examination body for which you apply, and with service providers (SMS, email, payment) strictly as needed.
Retention: incomplete registrations are deleted after 180 days of inactivity. Submitted registrations are retained until you request withdrawal, subject to legal requirements.
Your rights: you can request access, correction, or erasure of your data, or withdraw consent, by raising a helpdesk ticket under the category ‘Data privacy request’.

terms.title: Terms of use
body: Use this portal only to register and apply for examinations for yourself. Providing false information may lead to cancellation of candidature and legal action.
Do not share your password or OTP with anyone. You are responsible for all activity under your account.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
body: This portal aims to conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA and GIGW 3.0. It supports keyboard navigation, screen readers, text resizing and has sufficient colour contrast.
If you face any difficulty, please contact the helpdesk and we will assist you.

hyperlink.title: Hyperlinking policy
body: Links to external websites are provided for convenience. We are not responsible for their content. Prior permission is not required to link to this portal, but it must not be loaded into frames on your site.

copyright.title: Copyright policy
body: Content on this portal is the property of Vensysco Technologies Limited and the respective examination bodies. It may be reproduced free of charge with proper acknowledgement, but not for commercial purposes or in a misleading context.
